subject: 明代北方府城·赌场（原创扩展）
footprint_basis: 【建议值】沿宋临安casino同功能10×8；design/22 §3.4未细分此项。
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image 1 is the old game sprite to REBUILD with corrected ground projection. Reference image 2 is the exact geometric construction template; obey its four outer corners and all grid axes precisely, replace template with realistic thin grey stone paving and remove magenta and grid guide marks. Produce ONE Ming north China gambling hall, preserving image 1 grey brick flush hard-gabled roof, realistic grey tiles and wood detail, three open front bays with exactly two wooden gaming tables, bowls and tiny ivory counters, no people. Geometry is the priority: exact 2:1 dimetric, x ground axes at +0.500 and -0.500 slopes (26.565 degrees from horizontal), vertical walls straight vertical, orthographic no vanishing point. Ground footprint 10 by 8: left-to-front edge length 1.25 times front-to-right edge; use same 1536x1152 framing as image 2 and stone ground vertices L=(192,640), F=(832,960), R=(1344,704), B=(704,384). Three visible stone foundation corners must remain fully visible and readable with building inside pad. The pad must be flush 2-3 pixel thick, no thick plinth. Door/window beams follow template axes. Realistic painted strategy-game sprite matching reference material density, natural light upper left. True transparent RGBA surroundings with zero alpha outside building and stone pad. No shadows beyond footprint, no white background, no text, labels, watermark, modern items. Entire roof uncut. Rebuild correct perspective; do not inherit old incorrect wide-shallow footprint.
